prompts.rough: A low round ring of fieldstones filled with dark slate-grey water. In the middle a hollow grey weathered log stands on two forked posts as a column, one thick opaque ribbon of water dripping from its open end into the basin, ending in a pale foam ring. An ivory limestone crust has already grown over the forks and the stone rim. Beside it a wooden plank under the drip holds a boot, a ladle and a horseshoe, all turned to pale stone. One woman in a plain apron stands bent forward at the rim, large and clear, turning the objects over. Matte, dull, no shine, no gilding. Painted soft light, no cast shadows painted on the ground. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, not a front view.
prompts.grand: A round cut-stone basin with a thick column of ivory limestone flows in melted-candle shapes at its center. Four scalloped terraced pools of limestone, with raised rims and a few ochre streaks, descend in a fan around the column, each filled with dark slate water and a pale foam ring. A wooden scaffold and a ladder are caught inside the limestone, abandoned, and a mason's hammer and bucket are frozen in the stone. Fossilized grey wood. At most 4 pools. A single large woman with a broom stands at one pool. No shell shape, no mushroom shape, no man in the stone. Matte, dull, no shine, no gilding. Painted soft light, no cast shadows painted on the ground. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, not a front view.
prompts.mythic: One single huge open wave of ivory limestone rises from a round dark slate basin and leans to the right, as tall as a keep, its crest fringed with big rounded teeth, not curling over on itself. Its back is ivory with ochre streaks and one thick opaque ribbon of blue water runs down the spine. Three thick stone ribbons hang from the crest. An old grey log still sticks out of the foot, encrusted. Under the crest about a dozen big water drops hang frozen in mid-air at different heights, painted solid and fixed, no more than 12, each a clear rounded teardrop shape, no spray, no mist. A foam ring at the foot. Warm ochre and ivory stone, very little blue. No man in the stone, not a shell, not a mushroom, not a rock. Matte, dull, no shine, no gilding. Painted soft light, no cast shadows painted on the ground. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, not a front view.

prompts.rough: A low round vat of dark slate water. In the middle a patched upright barrel of mismatched staves tied with rope stands on a flat stone, a wooden funnel on top and a two-rung ladder leaning on it. Three clear round holes in the barrel each shoot a thick, opaque short arc of water that falls into the vat and ends in a pale foam ring. A fourth hole is plugged by the thumb of a boy apprentice, large and clear. An old woman cooper in a plain dress with a bucket stands on the ladder. Grey wood, rag patches, ochre and slate tones, no turquoise. Matte, dull, no shine, no gilding. Painted soft light, no cast shadows painted on the ground. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, not a front view.
prompts.grand: A round stone basin with a huge barrel the height of a house at its center, widest at mid-height, made of thick dark oak staves with matt iron hoops. A short wooden platform around the neck, a wooden funnel on top. Six thick opaque arcs of water at two heights, each coming out of a visible round hole in the staves and ending on a pale foam ring in the basin. A stone fish pond rim. Ochre and slate colours, no turquoise, no pastel. No chain of buckets, no gallery. One large woman stands at the foot. Matte, dull, no shine, no gilding. Painted soft light, no cast shadows painted on the ground. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, not a front view.
prompts.mythic: A gigantic black-oak barrel, enormous belly and narrowed at both ends, rising very tall over a round dark slate basin, with ship-hull ribs on its belly, thick matt iron hoops, no real windows. Exactly eight thick opaque arcs of water, in three crowns, the higher ones falling farther, each arc coming out of one clearly visible round hole in the staves and ending on its own pale foam ring in the basin. The arcs are thick solid ribbons, no drizzle, no mist, no fine threads, drawn clear against the dark wood. The funnel on top is black and empty. A carved shield on the center stave. Only 8 arcs, not an octopus, not a chandelier, not a tree. Ochre, slate and black oak colours, no turquoise, no rainbow. Matte, dull, no shine, no gilding. Painted soft light, no cast shadows painted on the ground. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab. Seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, not a front view.
